messages.subject: UAE and Saudi Executive Leadership | External Affairs, ESG and Country Operations
messages.body:
Dear Aquila Consulting team,

Your UAE and Saudi focus across executive search, Construction & Engineering, Corporate Support, and nationalisation makes this a targeted GCC introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans country-facing government and regulatory relations, external and corporate affairs, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance, executive advisory, and cross-functional delivery across a major mining operation.

Across 12+ years in mining, regulated financial services, and commercial operations, I have worked where major-project delivery, regulatory requirements, institutional relationships, sustainability commitments, and reputation priorities converge. Recent work includes ministry and regulator engagement, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, community and social-performance programs, executive communications, and complex issue coordination.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff, and Executive Operations roles across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, and Kuwait. Infrastructure, industrial development, mining, natural resources, and energy transition are priority sectors.

I would value consideration across your current and upcoming GCC mandates. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
